column2: To move phones, export a file on the old phone, transfer it, then choose Import JSON backup on the new phone. Reconnect Google and check task links after restoring.

column1: 组件会展示上次记录的目标，桌面可被旁人看到。跨日刷新可能受系统后台策略影响，打开应用后会补充刷新。
column2: The widget shows your previous goal and today's summary, which other people may see. System background limits can delay daily updates; opening the app refreshes it.

column1: 本地功能无需账号，无广告、无遥测。Google Tasks 仅在主动连接后同步。请主动导出需要保留的记录。

column1: 本次更新：可选 Google Tasks、双语界面、备份说明与公开维护。Google 接入状态请查看专门栏目。
column2: This update adds optional Google Tasks, two interface languages, clearer backup guidance and public maintenance. See the Google section for its availability.
